title: Locking, Unlocking, and Parking Sensor Behavior
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on locking and unlocking behavior, touch sensor usability, and parking sensor operation, with most examples describing issues or observations without a clearly coded sentiment.

positive.summary: One positive review praises the parking sensors for helping when backing into a space.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention repeated or unsuccessful locking and unlocking, settings that do not stay changed, touch sensor usability concerns, and mixed observations about parking sensor behavior and vehicle wake-up activity.

limitations: Most examples in this topic are coded as undetermined, so the sentiment signal is limited.
The cluster combines multiple related but distinct subjects, including door locking behavior, touch sensor design, parking sensor performance, alert settings, and vehicle wake-up behavior.
Examples are insufficient to separate software settings issues from hardware or sensor performance issues with confidence.
